    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">secp256k1算法详解五（kG点乘多梳状算法）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文对secp256k1最新实现的多梳状算法进行了深入的剖析，首先介绍了算法关键点，其次结合源码重点分析了查找表的生成过程，以及标量点乘的实现过程！
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>1 理论基础</h1>
<p>在椭圆曲线密码学（ECC）中，kG也称标量乘法运算，即把椭圆曲线上的基点G与标量k进行相乘的运算，结果是椭圆曲线上的另一个点R=kG，其定义为k个G连续相加的结果。该运算是椭圆曲线密钥生成、加解密、签名及验证中的核心运算，所以围绕它产生了多种加速算法，这里仅对secp256k1中前后出现的两种典型算法进行说明。<br><code></code></p>
<h2>1.1&nbsp;窗口查表算法（Windowed lookup）</h2>
<p>该算法是secp256k1库早期所使用的算法，其核心思想是将标量k（以256位标量为例）按<span class="mord"><span class="msupsub"><span class="vlist-t"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist"><span class="sizing reset-size6 size3 mtight"><span class="mord mtight"><span class="mord mathnormal mtight">bi<span class="mord mathnormal mtight">t<span class="mord mathnormal mtight">s位划分为256/<span class="mord"><span class="msupsub"><span class="vlist-t"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist"><span class="sizing reset-size6 size3 mtight"><span class="mord mtight"><span class="mord mathnormal mtight">bi<span class="mord mathnormal mtight">t<span class="mord mathnormal mtight">s个窗口，然后根据预计算查找表查找每个窗口值对应的点，再将每个窗口点相加即可得到最终结果R，其数学公式如下：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202510/465567-20251031155455161-769374683.png" alt="image" width="274" height="60" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>以窗口大小bits=4为例，则窗口数为256/4=64个，上述公式可以表示为：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202510/465567-20251031155627282-1358715527.png" alt="image" width="745" height="93" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>这里<em>k<sub>i</sub></em>为4bit二进制数，所以每个窗口包含2<sup>4</sup>=16个查找点（一个窗口对应点0G, 1G, 2G, ..., 15G），则包含16个窗口的查找表为64x16的二维数组，整个表的内存大小为64*16*sizeof(POINT)，假如POINT点x，y坐标都以32字节保存，则查找表所需的内存大小为64*16*(32+32)=64KB。这里如果将bits增大到16，则每个窗口包含2<sup>16</sup>=65536个查找点，窗口个数为256/16=16个，整个查找表大小为16*65536*sizeof(POINT)=64MB。</p>
<p>根据以上分析可知整个kG计算复杂度为O(256/bits)点加操作，例如当bits=4时，需要查找64次表再将对应结果点进行点加即可。</p>
<h2>1.2&nbsp;多梳状算法（Multi-Comb）</h2>
<p>为了严格的对应上源码，这里也加入了盲化部分内容，即计算R=kG时不直接进行计算，而是计算R=(k - b)*G + b*G，这样是为了防止攻击者通过分析功耗、电磁辐射等侧信道信息来推测出k，从而引入随机盲化值b，对于盲化后的计算公式，b*G可以预运算获得（对应后续源码中的ge_offset，通过查表计算出(k-b)*G后要加上该值才能得到最终值kG），所以对于任意的k，其实盲化后主要计算部分是(k - b)*G。在计算该部分时，使用了有符号数字多梳状算法，该算法中定义的comb(s, P)函数是一个关键内容：</p>
<p style="text-align: center">comb(s, P) = sum( (2*s[i] - 1) * 2^i * P ) for i=0..COMB_BITS-1</p>
<p>其中，s[i]是标量s的第i个比特值（0或1），P是椭圆曲线上点。公式中2*s[i] - 1是一个巧妙的转换：如果s[i] = 1，则2*1 - 1；如果s[i] = 0，则2*0 - 1 = -1，所以上式中对于每个比特位i，不是加上2^i*P就是减去2^i*P，这就是“有符号数字”的含义（系数是+1或-1），可以进一步将该式简化称一个更熟悉的形式：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>comb(s, P) = sum( (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>*s[i] - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^i *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> P )                                （1）
           </span>= [ sum( <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>*s[i]*<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^i ) - sum( <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^i ) ] *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> P
           </span>= [ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> * sum(s[i]*<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^i) - (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^COMB_BITS - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) ] *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> P
           </span>= [ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>*s - (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^COMB_BITS - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) ] * P</pre>
</div>
<h3>1. 将盲化与梳状算法结合</h3>
<p>最直接的想法是在计算(k - b)*G时，让其等于comb(s, G)，即有：</p>
<p style="text-align: center">(k - b) * G = comb(s, G) = [ 2*s - (2^COMB_BITS - 1) ] * G</p>
<p>由此可知只要解出相应s，即可通过调用（1）公式计算出(k-b)*G，s可以通过以下公式进行求解：</p>
<p style="text-align: center">s = (k - b + (2^COMB_BITS - 1)) / 2 (mod order)&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;(2)</p>
<p>这个公式需要对2进行模逆运算（相当于除法），在模运算中，除法是复杂且耗时的操作，需要避免。</p>
<h3>2. 避免模除2</h3>
<p>为了避免昂贵的模除2操作，这里采用了一个巧妙地优化，将公式中基点G除于2，不再计算comb(s, G)，而是计算comb(d, G/2)，仍利用最一开始的公式，则有：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>comb(d, G/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>) = sum( (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>*d[i] - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) * <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^i * (G/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>) )                         (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
             </span>= [ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>*d - (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^COMB_BITS - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) ] * (G/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
             </span>= [ d - (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^COMB_BITS - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> ] * G</pre>
</div>
<p>现在，令comb(d, G/2) = (k - b) * G，则有：</p>
<p style="text-align: center">(k - b) * G = [ d - (2^COMB_BITS - 1)/2 ] * G</p>
<p>得到：</p>
<p style="text-align: center">k - b = d - (2^COMB_BITS - 1)/2</p>
<p>最终解出d：</p>
<p style="text-align: center">d = k - b + (2^COMB_BITS - 1)/2 (mod order)　　(4)</p>
<p>这里(2^COMB_BITS - 1)/2 是一个常量，可以预先计算。现在，计算d只需要一次模加法和一次模减法，完全避免了模除运算。在后续的源码实现中定义偏移量scalar_offset=(2^COMB_BITS - 1)/2 - b (mod order)，则有d=k+scalar_offset，最终kG=(k-b)*G+b*G=comb(d, G/2)+ge_offset。</p>
<h3>3. 梳状含义</h3>
<p>在梳状算法中会将标量k拆分成多个位段，每个位段称之为块（Block），每个块中又有T个齿（Teeth），齿与齿之间又有S个间距（Spacing）。以源码中典型取值为例：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> COMB_BLOCKS 11
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> COMB_TEETH 6
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#define</span> COMB_SPACING 4</pre>
</div>
<p>表明会将标量k分成11块，每个块有6个齿，齿间距为4，则每个Block中包含24bits数据，梳子每次可以选中两两间隔为4的6bits数据，在这样的结构下11个块可以包含264bits数据，完全覆盖256bits的标量k（标量k还需进行数据位填充）。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202512/465567-20251204114220416-1675856688.png" alt="image" width="1462" height="155" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>定义mask(b) = sum(2^((b*COMB_TEETH + t)*COMB_SPACING) for t=0..COMB_TEETH-1)，则当b取值从0到COMB_BLOCKS-1时，有以下对应关系：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)  = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>   + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>   + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>   + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
mask(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)  = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">24</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">28</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">36</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">40</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">44</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
mask(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>)  = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">48</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">52</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">56</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">64</span>  + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">68</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
...
mask(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>) = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">240</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">244</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">248</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">252</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">256</span> + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">260</span></pre>
</div>
<p>由此可通过这些掩码拆分比特位d[i]，具体来说，每个掩码会被使用COMB_SPACING次，且每次使用时的偏移量不同。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>d = (d &amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)&lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) + (d &amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)&lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) + ... + (d &amp; mask(COMB_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)&lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    (d </span>&amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)&lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) + (d &amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)&lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) + ... + (d &amp; mask(COMB_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)&lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    ...
    (d </span>&amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)&lt;&lt;(COMB_SPACING-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)) + ...</pre>
</div>
<p>接下来定义：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>table(b, m) = (m - mask(b)/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>) * G                             （5）</pre>
</div>
<p>这里b=0..COMB_BLOCKS-1，m=(d &amp; mask(b))，m是标量d在b块中对应的值，每个块对应的m可以有2^COMB_TEETH个不同取值，可以预计算m对应的点乘值m*G。</p>
<p>table(b, m) = (m - mask(b)/2)*G = ((d&amp;mask(b)) - mask(b)/2)*G = (2(d&amp;mask(b)) - mask(b))*G/2 = ((2d - 1)&amp;mask(b))*G/2 = sum(2^i * (2*d[i] - 1) * G/2) 这里i遍历掩码mask(b)中的置位比特位，即最终有：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>table(b, m) = sum(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^i * (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>*d[i] - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) * G/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>)                   （6）</pre>
</div>
<p>例如当m=2^48 + 2^56 + 2^68时（位于块2中的值），则有table(2, m) =&nbsp;(2^48 - 2^52 + 2^56 - 2^60 - 2^64 + 2^68) * G/2。&nbsp;</p>
<p>结合以上定义，可以重写comb(d, G/2)：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>comb(d, G/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>) = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> * (table(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, d&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)) + ... + table(COMB_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, d&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> &amp; mask(COMP_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))                               （7）
             </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> * (table(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, d&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> &amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)) + ... + table(COMB_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, d&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> &amp; mask(COMP_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))
             </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> * (table(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, d&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> &amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)) + ... + table(COMB_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, d&gt;&gt;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> &amp; mask(COMP_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)))
             </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ...
             </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^(COMB_SPACING-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) * (table(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, d&gt;&gt;(COMB_SPACING-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>) &amp; mask(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>)) + ...)</pre>
</div>
<p>即：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>sum(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>^i * sum(table(b, d&gt;&gt;i &amp; mask(b)), b=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>..COMB_BLOCKS-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>), i=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>..COMB_SPACING-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>以下是计算过程伪代码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>c =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> infinity
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> comb_off <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> range(COMB_SPACING - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, -<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> block <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> range(COMB_BLOCKS):
    c </span>+= table(block, (d &gt;&gt; comb_off) &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mask(block))
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> comb_off &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    c </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>*<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">c
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> c</pre>
</div>
<p>在以上伪代码中，梳子是从高位“梳到”低位的，即依次先处理每个块的高位，再依次处理每个块的低位。</p>
<h3>4. 折半表</h3>
<p>之前已经有结论每个块对应的m可以有2^COMB_TEETH个不同取值，所以对于table(b, m)来说需要有2^COMB_TEETH个表项才能覆盖该b块所有可能取值，但实际上只需一半的表项即可覆盖所有可能取值，即table(b, m)实际只包含2^(COMB_TEETH-1)个表项，以下是分析过程：</p>
<p>由m=(d &amp; mask(b))，令m'是m所有位反转对应的值，则有m'=m XOR mask(b)，进而有table(b, m') = table(b, m XOR mask(b)) = table(b, mask(b) - m)&nbsp; = (mask(b) - m - mask(b)/2)*G = -(m - mask(b)/2)*G = -table(b, m)。</p>
<p>即如果m'对应是m的所有位反转，那么m'对应的table表项即为m相应表项的负值，对于任意椭圆点<span class="math-inline" data-math="P = (x, y)">P = (x, y)，其负值很容易求得即-P = (x, -y)，所以table(b, m)表只需保存一半的表项，另一半的位反转表项，只需对相应的表项取负即可。对于0块来说，当梳齿对应块中最低位时，有以下对应关系：</span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202512/465567-20251205103632352-2066426107.png" alt="image" width="467" height="273" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>例如由m=2^0 + 2^8&nbsp; + 2^16时的表项（对应点P=(x, y)），可以直接求出m'=2^4 + 2^12 + 2^20的表项（对应点-P = (x, -y)），只需要对m值对应的表项中y值取负即可得到m'值对应的表项。</p>
<h1>2 源码详解</h1>
<h2>2.1 预计算表</h2>
<p>函数secp256k1_ecmult_gen_compute_table用于产生第1节中的table(b, m)表项，函数源码如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> secp256k1_ecmult_gen_compute_table(secp256k1_ge_storage* table, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> secp256k1_ge* gen, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> blocks, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> teeth, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> spacing) {

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  3</span>     size_t points_total = points * blocks;                                                      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 总共预计算的点数 = 每个块的预计算点数 * 块数</span>

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 99</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">100</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Free memory. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">101</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">free</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(vs);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">102</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">free</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(ds);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">103</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">free</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(prec);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">104</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>正如之前分析代码中第2行给出了每个块儿需要进行预计算点的个数（即table(b, m)在固定b时的表项数），COMB_TEETH=6时，表项数是2^5=32个；第3行为b取值从0到COMB_BLOCKS-1时完整表中点的总数，以COMB_BLOCKS=11为例，点的总数是32*11=352；接下来第4~6行为对应的表项分配内存空间，其中ds用于存储在每个块中梳齿对应的“权重”，所以其大小是梳齿个数6，以0块儿为例，其取值为2*G/2，2*2^4*G/2，2*2^8*G/2，2*2^12*G/2，2*2^16*G/2，2*2^20*G/2，后续给出详细求解过程；第17~26行先求得标量1/2 mod order，再用通用的倍点加法求射影点u=G/2；第28，29行分别获取点u对应的仿射坐标及存储坐标值；第33~38行验证部分是检查2*u是否等于生成点G。</p>
<p>接下来，第11行处的for循环用于对11个块儿，依次求块对应的table(b, m)内容；之后第44，45行定义临时变量sum，并将其初始化为零点，第46行的for循环用于求之前所说的ds，以及公式（6）中减数部分的累加和sum；具体来说，第47，48行给出了后续u和sum的具体计算公式；接下来第49行将上轮更新过的u加到sum上（两个for循环都为第一次时，u值为G/2，加完以后sum=G/2）;之后第51行将u翻倍，例如在tooth=0时，u=2*G/2；第53~60行，先将u赋值给ds[tooth]，然后再将u翻SPACING-1倍，算上第51行翻倍u相当于共翻倍SPACING次（当SPACING=4时对应2^4），另外55行的if判断用于在最后一个块最后一次时，由于不再使用这时已无需对u再进行SPACING-1次翻倍操作，for循环完毕已经依次求出之前所说的梳齿“权重”——ds，以及公式（6）中减数部分的累加和——sum。</p>
<p>第69行将累加和取负（因为sum对应公式中的减数部分）后，赋值给当前块中的第一个表项vs[pos]，对应所有梳齿位都位0时表项值，接下来，第77行for循环分别计算梳齿0，1，...，teeth-2齿位对应是1时的table的表项值；第78行用于计算对应梳齿位为1时表项的个数，如第0个梳齿位为1时，只能产生2^0=1个表项000001，第1个梳齿位为1时，可以产生2^1=2个表项000010和000011，第2个梳齿位为1时，可以产生2^2=4个表项000100，000101，000110，000111，依次类推第teeth-2=4齿位对应是1时，可以产生2^4=16个表项；之后第80~82行的for循环依次产生之前折半表部分图中前半部分对应的表项值，总个数是1+1+2+4+..+16=32。</p>
<p>代码接下来的内容主要是坐标转换相关内容，这里不再进行详细解释，总之循环执行完毕会产生所有11个块对用的查找表。</p>
<h2>2.2 计算k*G</h2>
<p>接下来需要看如何利用上一小节产生的查找表进行k*G计算，仍旧先给出计算函数secp256k1_ecmult_gen源码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> secp256k1_ecmult_gen(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> secp256k1_ecmult_gen_context *ctx, secp256k1_gej *r, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> secp256k1_scalar *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">gn) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    uint32_t comb_off;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    secp256k1_ge add;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    secp256k1_fe neg;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    secp256k1_ge_storage adds;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    secp256k1_scalar d;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  7</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Array of uint32_t values large enough to store COMB_BITS bits. Only the bottom
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * 8 are ever nonzero, but having the zero padding at the end if COMB_BITS&gt;256
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">  9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * avoids the need to deal with out-of-bounds reads from a scalar. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 10</span>     uint32_t recoded[(COMB_BITS + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">31</span>) &gt;&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>] = {<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">};
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> first = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, i;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 12</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 13</span>     memset(&amp;adds, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(adds));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 14</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 15</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> We want to compute R = gn*G.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * To blind the scalar used in the computation, we rewrite this to be
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 18</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * R = (gn - b)*G + b*G, with a blinding value b determined by the context.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * The multiplication (gn-b)*G will be performed using a signed-digit multi-comb (see Section
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 21</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * 3.3 of "Fast and compact elliptic-curve cryptography" by Mike Hamburg,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 22</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1); text-decoration: underline">https://eprint.iacr.org/2012/309</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">).
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Let comb(s, P) = sum((2*s[i]-1)*2^i*P for i=0..COMB_BITS-1), where s[i] is the i'th bit of
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * the binary representation of scalar s. So the s[i] values determine whether -2^i*P (s[i]=0)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 26</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * or +2^i*P (s[i]=1) are added together. COMB_BITS is at least 256, so all bits of s are
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 27</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * covered. By manipulating:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 28</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 29</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     comb(s, P) = sum((2*s[i]-1)*2^i*P for i=0..COMB_BITS-1)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * &lt;=&gt; comb(s, P) = sum((2*s[i]-1)*2^i for i=0..COMB_BITS-1) * P
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 31</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * &lt;=&gt; comb(s, P) = (2*sum(s[i]*2^i for i=0..COMB_BITS-1) - sum(2^i for i=0..COMB_BITS-1)) * P
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 32</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * &lt;=&gt; comb(s, P) = (2*s - (2^COMB_BITS - 1)) * P
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 33</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * If we wanted to compute (gn-b)*G as comb(s, G), it would need to hold that
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 35</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 36</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     (gn - b) * G = (2*s - (2^COMB_BITS - 1)) * G
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 37</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * &lt;=&gt; s = (gn - b + (2^COMB_BITS - 1))/2 (mod order)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 38</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 39</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * We use an alternative here that avoids the modular division by two: instead we compute
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 40</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * (gn-b)*G as comb(d, G/2). For that to hold it must be the case that
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 41</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 42</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     (gn - b) * G = (2*d - (2^COMB_BITS - 1)) * (G/2)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 43</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * &lt;=&gt; d = gn - b + (2^COMB_BITS - 1)/2 (mod order)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 44</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 45</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Adding precomputation, our final equations become:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 46</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 47</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     ctx-&gt;scalar_offset = (2^COMB_BITS - 1)/2 - b (mod order)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 48</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     ctx-&gt;ge_offset = b*G
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 49</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     d = gn + ctx-&gt;scalar_offset (mod order)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 50</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     R = comb(d, G/2) + ctx-&gt;ge_offset
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 51</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 52</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * comb(d, G/2) function is then computed by summing + or - 2^(i-1)*G, for i=0..COMB_BITS-1,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 53</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * depending on the value of the bits d[i] of the binary representation of scalar d.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 54</span>      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 55</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 56</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Compute the scalar d = (gn + ctx-&gt;scalar_offset). </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 57</span>     secp256k1_scalar_add(&amp;d, &amp;ctx-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">scalar_offset, gn);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 58</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Convert to recoded array. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 59</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (i = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; i &lt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span> &amp;&amp; i &lt; ((COMB_BITS + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">31</span>) &gt;&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>); ++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 60</span>         recoded[i] = secp256k1_scalar_get_bits_limb32(&amp;d, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span> * i, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">32</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 61</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 62</span>     secp256k1_scalar_clear(&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">d);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 63</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 64</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> In secp256k1_ecmult_gen_prec_table we have precomputed sums of the
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 65</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * (2*d[i]-1) * 2^(i-1) * G points, for various combinations of i positions.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 66</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * We rewrite our equation in terms of these table entries.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 67</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 68</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Let mask(b) = sum(2^((b*COMB_TEETH + t)*COMB_SPACING) for t=0..COMB_TEETH-1),
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 69</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * with b ranging from 0 to COMB_BLOCKS-1. So for example with COMB_BLOCKS=11,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 70</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * COMB_TEETH=6, COMB_SPACING=4, we would have:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 71</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   mask(0)  = 2^0   + 2^4   + 2^8   + 2^12  + 2^16  + 2^20,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 72</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   mask(1)  = 2^24  + 2^28  + 2^32  + 2^36  + 2^40  + 2^44,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 73</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   mask(2)  = 2^48  + 2^52  + 2^56  + 2^60  + 2^64  + 2^68,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 74</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   ...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 75</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   mask(10) = 2^240 + 2^244 + 2^248 + 2^252 + 2^256 + 2^260
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 76</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 77</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * We will split up the bits d[i] using these masks. Specifically, each mask is
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 78</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * used COMB_SPACING times, with different shifts:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 79</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 80</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * d = (d &amp; mask(0)&lt;&lt;0) + (d &amp; mask(1)&lt;&lt;0) + ... + (d &amp; mask(COMB_BLOCKS-1)&lt;&lt;0) +
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 81</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     (d &amp; mask(0)&lt;&lt;1) + (d &amp; mask(1)&lt;&lt;1) + ... + (d &amp; mask(COMB_BLOCKS-1)&lt;&lt;1) +
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 82</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     ...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 83</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     (d &amp; mask(0)&lt;&lt;(COMB_SPACING-1)) + ...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 84</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 85</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Now define table(b, m) = (m - mask(b)/2) * G, and we will precompute these values for
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 86</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * b=0..COMB_BLOCKS-1, and for all values m which (d &amp; mask(b)) can take (so m can take on
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 87</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * 2^COMB_TEETH distinct values).
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 88</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 89</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * If m=(d &amp; mask(b)), then table(b, m) is the sum of 2^i * (2*d[i]-1) * G/2, with i
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 90</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * iterating over the set bits in mask(b). In our example, table(2, 2^48 + 2^56 + 2^68)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 91</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * would equal (2^48 - 2^52 + 2^56 - 2^60 - 2^64 + 2^68) * G/2.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 92</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 93</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * With that, we can rewrite comb(d, G/2) as:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 94</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 95</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     2^0 * (table(0, d&gt;&gt;0 &amp; mask(0)) + ... + table(COMB_BLOCKS-1, d&gt;&gt;0 &amp; mask(COMP_BLOCKS-1)))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 96</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   + 2^1 * (table(0, d&gt;&gt;1 &amp; mask(0)) + ... + table(COMB_BLOCKS-1, d&gt;&gt;1 &amp; mask(COMP_BLOCKS-1)))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 97</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   + 2^2 * (table(0, d&gt;&gt;2 &amp; mask(0)) + ... + table(COMB_BLOCKS-1, d&gt;&gt;2 &amp; mask(COMP_BLOCKS-1)))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 98</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   + ...
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 99</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   + 2^(COMB_SPACING-1) * (table(0, d&gt;&gt;(COMB_SPACING-1) &amp; mask(0)) + ...)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">100</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">101</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Or more generically as
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">102</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">103</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   sum(2^i * sum(table(b, d&gt;&gt;i &amp; mask(b)), b=0..COMB_BLOCKS-1), i=0..COMB_SPACING-1)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">104</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">105</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * This is implemented using an outer loop that runs in reverse order over the lines of this
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">106</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * equation, which in each iteration runs an inner loop that adds the terms of that line and
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">107</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * then doubles the result before proceeding to the next line.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">108</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">109</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * In pseudocode:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">110</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   c = infinity
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">111</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   for comb_off in range(COMB_SPACING - 1, -1, -1):
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">112</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     for block in range(COMB_BLOCKS):
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">113</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *       c += table(block, (d &gt;&gt; comb_off) &amp; mask(block))
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">114</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *     if comb_off &gt; 0:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">115</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *       c = 2*c
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">116</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *   return c
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">117</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">118</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * This computes c = comb(d, G/2), and thus finally R = c + ctx-&gt;ge_offset. Note that it would
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">119</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * be possible to apply an initial offset instead of a final offset (moving ge_offset to take
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">120</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * the place of infinity above), but the chosen approach allows using (in a future improvement)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">121</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * an incomplete addition formula for most of the multiplication.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">122</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">123</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * The last question is how to implement the table(b, m) function. For any value of b,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">124</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * m=(d &amp; mask(b)) can only take on at most 2^COMB_TEETH possible values (the last one may have
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">125</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * fewer as there mask(b) may exceed the curve order). So we could create COMB_BLOCK tables
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">126</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * which contain a value for each such m value.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">127</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">128</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Now note that if m=(d &amp; mask(b)), then flipping the relevant bits of m results in negating
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">129</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * the result of table(b, m). This is because table(b,m XOR mask(b)) = table(b, mask(b) - m) =
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">130</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * (mask(b) - m - mask(b)/2)*G = (-m + mask(b)/2)*G = -(m - mask(b)/2)*G = -table(b, m).
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">131</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Because of this it suffices to only store the first half of the m values for every b. If an
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">132</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * entry from the second half is needed, we look up its bit-flipped version instead, and negate
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">133</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * it.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">134</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">135</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * secp256k1_ecmult_gen_prec_table[b][index] stores the table(b, m) entries. Index
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">136</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * is the relevant mask(b) bits of m packed together without gaps. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">137</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">138</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Outer loop: iterate over comb_off from COMB_SPACING - 1 down to 0. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">139</span>     comb_off = COMB_SPACING - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">140</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">141</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        uint32_t block;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">142</span>         uint32_t bit_pos =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> comb_off;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">143</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Inner loop: for each block, add table entries to the result. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">144</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (block = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; block &lt; COMB_BLOCKS; ++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">block) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">145</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Gather the mask(block)-selected bits of d into bits. They're packed:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">146</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * bits[tooth] = d[(block*COMB_TEETH + tooth)*COMB_SPACING + comb_off]. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">147</span>             uint32_t bits = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, sign, abs, index, tooth;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">148</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Instead of reading individual bits here to construct the bits variable,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">149</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * build up the result by xoring rotated reads together. In every iteration,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">150</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * one additional bit is made correct, starting at the bottom. The bits
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">151</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * above that contain junk. This reduces leakage by avoiding computations
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">152</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * on variables that can have only a low number of possible values (e.g.,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">153</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * just two values when reading a single bit into a variable.) See:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">154</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1); text-decoration: underline">https://www.usenix.org/system/files/conference/usenixsecurity18/sec18-alam.pdf</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">155</span>              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">156</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (tooth = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; tooth &lt; COMB_TEETH; ++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tooth) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">157</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Construct bitdata s.t. the bottom bit is the bit we'd like to read.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">158</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">159</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 * We could just set bitdata = recoded[bit_pos &gt;&gt; 5] &gt;&gt; (bit_pos &amp; 0x1f)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">160</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 * but this would simply discard the bits that fall off at the bottom,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">161</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 * and thus, for example, bitdata could still have only two values if we
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">162</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 * happen to shift by exactly 31 positions. We use a rotation instead,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">163</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 * which ensures that bitdata doesn't lose entropy. This relies on the
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">164</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 * rotation being atomic, i.e., the compiler emitting an actual rot
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">165</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">                 * instruction. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">166</span>                 uint32_t bitdata = secp256k1_rotr32(recoded[bit_pos &gt;&gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>], bit_pos &amp; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x1f</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">167</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">168</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Clear the bit at position tooth, but sssh, don't tell clang. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">169</span>                 uint32_t <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">volatile</span> vmask = ~(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> &lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tooth);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">170</span>                 bits &amp;=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> vmask;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">171</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">172</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Write the bit into position tooth (and junk into higher bits). </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">173</span>                 bits ^= bitdata &lt;&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> tooth;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">174</span>                 bit_pos +=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> COMB_SPACING;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">175</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">176</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">177</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> If the top bit of bits is 1, flip them all (corresponding to looking up
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">178</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             * the negated table value), and remember to negate the result in sign. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">179</span>             sign = (bits &gt;&gt; (COMB_TEETH - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>)) &amp; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">180</span>             abs = (bits ^ -sign) &amp; (COMB_POINTS - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">181</span>             VERIFY_CHECK(sign == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> || sign == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">182</span>             VERIFY_CHECK(abs &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> COMB_POINTS);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">183</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">184</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">* This uses a conditional move to avoid any secret data in array indexes.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">185</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *   _Any_ use of secret indexes has been demonstrated to result in timing
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">186</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *   sidechannels, even when the cache-line access patterns are uniform.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">187</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *  See also:
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">188</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *   "A word of warning", CHES 2013 Rump Session, by Daniel J. Bernstein and Peter Schwabe
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">189</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *    (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1); text-decoration: underline">https://cryptojedi.org/peter/data/chesrump-20130822.pdf</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">) and
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">190</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *   "Cache Attacks and Countermeasures: the Case of AES", RSA 2006,
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">191</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *    by Dag Arne Osvik, Adi Shamir, and Eran Tromer
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">192</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">             *    (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1); text-decoration: underline">https://eprint.iacr.org/2005/271.pdf</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">193</span>              <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">194</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (index = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>; index &lt; COMB_POINTS; ++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">index) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">195</span>                 secp256k1_ge_storage_cmov(&amp;adds, &amp;secp256k1_ecmult_gen_prec_table[block][index], index ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> abs);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">196</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">197</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">198</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Set add=adds or add=-adds, in constant time, based on sign. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">199</span>             secp256k1_ge_from_storage(&amp;add, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">adds);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">200</span>             secp256k1_fe_negate(&amp;neg, &amp;add.y, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">201</span>             secp256k1_fe_cmov(&amp;add.y, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">neg, sign);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">202</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">203</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Add the looked up and conditionally negated value to r. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">204</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (EXPECT(first, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)) {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">205</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> If this is the first table lookup, we can skip addition. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">206</span>                 secp256k1_gej_set_ge(r, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">add);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">207</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Give the entry a random Z coordinate to blind intermediary results. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">208</span>                 secp256k1_gej_rescale(r, &amp;ctx-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">proj_blind);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">209</span>                 first = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">210</span>             } <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">211</span>                 secp256k1_gej_add_ge(r, r, &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">add);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">212</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">213</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">214</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">215</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Double the result, except in the last iteration. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">216</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (comb_off-- == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">217</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        secp256k1_gej_double(r, r);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">218</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">219</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">220</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Correct for the scalar_offset added at the start (ge_offset = b*G, while b was
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">221</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * subtracted from the input scalar gn). </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">222</span>     secp256k1_gej_add_ge(r, r, &amp;ctx-&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">ge_offset);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">223</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">224</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Cleanup. </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">225</span>     secp256k1_fe_clear(&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">neg);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">226</span>     secp256k1_ge_clear(&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">add);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">227</span>     secp256k1_memclear_explicit(&amp;adds, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(adds));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">228</span>     secp256k1_memclear_explicit(&amp;recoded, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sizeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(recoded));
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">229</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>源码第10给出一个位重编码变量recoded，用于存放标量gn（也即之前说的k）的二级制位，仍以之前的梳状结构为例，则COMB_BITS=11*6*4=264bits，则recoded长度为9，这时9*(1&lt;&lt;5)=288&gt;264可以完全存储相应的重编码位；源码中的注释对应上一节的解析内容，接下来不再详细进行说明；第57行应用公式（4）对d进行求解；第59~62行从256bits的标量d中依次取出32bits并放入到recoded中，在32位实现下这里相当于把d中数据直接拷贝到recoded。</p>
<p>接下来是函数实现主体部分，首先第139行将comb_off初始化为COMB_SPACING-1，即从梳子从块儿的高位开始；之后140行处的while会依次处理comb_off位对应的各个梳齿取值，直到comb_off移动至0位；第142行将bit_pos初始化为com_off，梳齿对应第0块的高位；随后第144行用for循环依次处理COMB_BLOCKS个块儿；第156行使用for循环对于当前块儿的COMB_TEETH个梳齿位依次进行处理；第166行将包含bit_pos位的recoded[]进行循环右移，使得结果bitdata的最低位正好是我们需要的bit_pos位；第169行是tooth齿对应的掩码vmask，在掩码中tooth位为0其他位为1；第170行通过与掩码vmask做且操作清除目标位；接下来第173行将刚刚提取的位（bitdata最低位）写入到bits的第tooth个位置，bitdata&lt;&lt; tooth将包含所需位的32位数通过左移到将最低位移动到正确的位置——tooth，然后通过异或来将tooth值写入到bits（上一步已将bits的tooth位清零，零与其他值异或保留其他值）；随后第174行将bit_pos移动到下一个梳齿位。可以看出循环结束后bits会在低COMB_TEETH位依次记录下当前块的梳齿位对应的值（bits低COMB_TEETH位以外值为无效数据），即将块儿中相应值“梳”出来。</p>
<p>之后，第179行将“梳”出来的bits最高位做为符号位；第180行取得除符号外，其他位实际应该的取值abs，其中-sign为mask，sign=0时，对应mask=0x00000000，sign=1时，对应mask=0xFFFFFFFF，即sign=0时取bits值（与0异或取原址），sign=1时bits值每个位都取反（与1异或取反值），之后通过&amp;(COMB_POINT-1)获取bits mask后的低5bit值；第194~196行处的for循环取值abs对应的table表项值；第199~201行根据符号位确定是否进行取负操作；第204~212行根据是否为第一次将相应的表项值赋值或者附加到r上，在第一次时还可以会用proj_blind对r初始值进行盲化操作：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/465567/202512/465567-20251205164304911-1153325486.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<p>由图中解释可知经过盲化操作后，点r'虽然各个坐标分量的取值都已经都已经改变，但是由射影坐标的定义可知，其实r'和r对应同样的仿射坐标，即它们表示同一个点。</p>
<p>当144行的for循环执行完毕，表示当前comb_off梳齿位对应的所有块儿已经处理完毕，接下来第216行将梳齿向低位移位继续进行下一个梳齿位对应块的处理，直到COMB_SPACING=4个梳齿位都处理完毕则跳出while循环；另外因为梳齿位是从高位到低位进行的，所以第217行对r进行了翻倍操作，这相当于公式（7）中每行内的移位操作。</p>
<p>整个while循环执行完毕后得到的值r=(gn - b)*G，最终gn*G=(gn - b)*G + b*G，所以在222行又在r上加上了ge_offset=b*G，最终得到gn*G，求解结束。</p>
<h2>2.3 补充说明</h2>
<p>从上面的分析可知分块数COMB_BLOCKS和梳齿数COMB_TEETH共同决定了查找表的大小，其中分块数对查找表是线性影响，而梳齿数对查找表是指数级影响（影响更大），所以在内存受限或者优先考虑内存时，需要对这两个参数的取值进行斟酌考虑。另外COMB_BLOCKS决定了查表访存次数和点加操作次数，而COMB_SPACING决定了倍点操作次数，在进行CUDA编程时都需要根据实际情况，斟酌确定相关参数的取值。</p>
</div>
